board: Winsen ZPHS01B multi-in-one sensor module (XH2.54-4P: GND, +5V, RXD, TXD)
reason: Modelled from the Winsen ZPHS01B manual V1.3: Q&A read command FF 01 86 ... 79 answered with the 26-byte frame (PM1.0/PM2.5/PM10, CO2, VOC grade, temperature (raw-500)x0.1, RH, CH2O x0.001, CO x0.1, O3 x0.01, NO2 x0.01) and check byte (NOT(sum bytes 1-24))+1; driver verified against the datasheet's example frame. +5V gets its own 5 V supply (500 mA peak). Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico.
breakoutPinoutSource: Winsen ZPHS01B manual V1.3 'Pin Definition' table (PIN1 GND, PIN2 +5V, PIN3 RXD, PIN4 TXD; XH2.54-4P), https://www.winsen-sensor.com/d/files/zphs01b-english-version1_1-20200713.pdf
